examples.description: Structure-only example for authoring one nominal request and one calibrated-boundary request against a sealed capability while selecting trusted private fixtures.

nominal_case.request: author one complete task-neutral request that satisfies the sealed request_schema and any request_domain supplied by the selected instance; request_anchors are evidence, not prescribed values
nominal_case.instance_id: select one supplied nominal scene/reset fixture by instance_id
nominal_case.criteria: copy the complete sealed criteria array byte-for-value

calibrated_boundary_case.request: author a different complete task-neutral request that satisfies the sealed request_schema and any request_domain supplied by the selected instance; request_anchors are evidence, not prescribed values
calibrated_boundary_case.instance_id: select one supplied calibrated-boundary scene/reset fixture by instance_id
calibrated_boundary_case.criteria: copy the complete sealed criteria array byte-for-value

examples.not_an_oracle: The example supplies no concrete IDs, request values, numeric thresholds, task mapping, waypoint, call sequence, or expected verdict.
